title: BNCI 2022-001 EEG Correlates of Difficulty Level dataset
description: EEG recordings from 13 healthy participants piloting a simulated drone through circular waypoints at varying difficulty levels using a joystick. The dataset includes one offline session with a v-shaped difficulty schedule and two online sessions in which EEG-decoded subjective difficulty was used for closed-loop adaptation. It supports research on decoding workload and difficulty from EEG and on adaptive visuomotor learning in brain-machine interfaces.
methods_description: 64-channel Biosemi ActiveTwo EEG (plus 3 EOG channels) was recorded at 2048 Hz and downsampled to 256 Hz. Data were band-pass filtered at 1-40 Hz, SPHARA spatially filtered, common-average referenced, and cleaned of EOG artifacts with ICA. In the offline session, participants flew 32 trajectories of 32 waypoints each. In the online sessions, each condition consisted of 12 trajectories with decision points for difficulty adaptation. LDA and elastic-net GLM classifiers were used for decoding.
